articleTitle: Machining Simulation Application Based on Improved Marching Cubes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Cutting simulation is a key part of the machining simulation system, and the cutting algorithm directly affects the efficiency and accuracy of the simulation. Based on the Marching Cubes algorithm, a new cutting algorithm is proposed by modifying the voxel model. The median method is used to replace the linear interpolation method, reducing a large number of floating point operations and using the GPU for parallel computing. The simulation results show that the re-drawing process of the cutting surface based on the improved algorithm is more concise and can have higher cutting efficiency while ensuring cutting accuracy. However, as the algorithm requires different memory space depending on the discrete accuracy of the blank, when the discrete accuracy of the blank exceeds a certain level, it will increase the computational volume of the cutting calculation, which in turn reduces the efficiency of the cutting calculation. The improved cutting algorithm is more suitable for complex workpiece machining and can effectively improve the efficiency of the simulation.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of Mosquitto Theme Subscription Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss and study the topic subscription mechanism of Mosquitto, an open source proxy server of MQTT, point out the defects of its subscription tree structure, and propose to modify and optimize the structure of the subscription tree by using a combination of radix tree and hash table. The constant-level matching time complexity and further compression of the memory space occupied by the subscription tree are achieved, which effectively improves the operational efficiency and stability of Mosquitto under the situation of insufficient system resources.

articleTitle: The Improvement of Scheduling Algorithm Based on Token Bucket and Weighted Fair Queue
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the surge of traffic and types carried by the network, the possibility of congestion in the network is increasing. However, the traditional queue scheduling algorithm has been unable to meet the network quality of service (QoS). Aiming at this situation, based on the analysis of token bucket algorithm and various queue scheduling algorithms, an improved token bucket and weighted fair queue (WFQ) scheduling algorithm is proposed. Simulation experiments show that the algorithm can effectively carry out flow control and flow shaping. At the same time, by adjusting the weight of the queue length, it will guarantee the network quality of service of the real-time data flow and improve the performance of network delay, jitter and data packet loss rate.

articleTitle: Application of Continuous Time Link Prediction in Traceability of Water Environment Pollution
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the rapid development of production and consumption, water pollution incidents are increasing day by day. Point source pollution is the main way for pollutants to enter rivers, and identifying pollution sources is very important for water pollution management. This paper concretizes the problem of pollution source tracing, uses scientific algorithms to transform it into a link prediction problem, and proposes a continuous dynamic link prediction algorithm. The model learns the representation of the time dynamic information of monitoring points and pollution point sources, and predicts the links of nodes through classifiers. Using the monitoring data of water pollution in Fuxin City, the feasibility of the model is verified.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Industrial Internet Application Layer Protocol Integrating AES and RSA Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing application layer protocols (http, smtp, ftp) are difficult to fully meet the communication and transmission of industrial data in the network, this paper proposes an industrial Internet application layer protocol QSHQ (Quick-Security-HQ) that supports multiple underlying bearer protocols (MQTT, WebSocket) based on various factors such as security, real-time, versatility, and scalability. QSHQ (Quick-Security-HQ) unifies the format and message structure of industrial data in network transmission, avoids repeated design in industrial Internet development, and at the same time, addresses the security issues of transmission in industrial data networks. In the process of QSHQ message transmission, AES and RSA hybrid encryption technology is used to realize the encryption and decryption of data. Based on this, a set of CNC machine tool security interaction system is designed. The system shows that the protocol can avoid reading and tampering data in network transmission, avoid the network risk caused by the interconnection between CNC network and other networks, and has good real-time performance and versatility, which can provide basic support for industrial data in network transmission.

articleTitle: Topology Recognition of Power Internet of Things Based on Absolute Correlation Degree and Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: As more and more stations and devices are connected to the power IoT, their topologies are becoming more and more complex, and it is a challenge to identify their topologies effectively and correctly so as to grasp the status of the power IoT. Problems existing in the existing research: as distributed renewable energy such as wind power is connected to the low-voltage distribution station area, the topology structure of the station area is also complicated, and the accuracy of its topology identification is difficult to guarantee. In view of the current topology of power IoT can not be dynamically updated in time, poor recognition accuracy and other problems, this paper we prepose a power IoT topology recognition based on absolute correlation degree and clustering algorithm. The result of an example shows that this method can correctly discriminate which station and feeder the user is under, improving the accuracy and efficiency of topology identification.

articleTitle: Design of Mobile Geographic Information System Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of mobile internet, geographic information systems based on mobile technology are deeply integrating into our lives and changing the traditional GIS work mode. With the transformation of GIS in various fields, it is completely feasible to apply the latest GIS technologies such as map application programming interface to mobile geographic information systems. This paper analyzes the system requirements, overall design, and detailed design of a city's mobile geographic information system development. Using ESRI's ArcGIS Runtime mobile development package and ArcGIS API for Android-based mobile GIS development technology, functions such as online tile service and feature service download, local feature service editing and uploading, map zooming and panning, GPS positioning, layer control, map annotation, nearby query, data query, distance and area measurement, statistical analysis, data comparison, and data management were implemented, ultimately achieving an Android-based mobile geographic information system.

articleTitle: Code Recommendation Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Software developers, especially programming beginners, often need to complete some unfamiliar coding tasks, generally by reusing the previous code or searching the existing code snippets, and from a large number of redundant search results to screen out the code with similar structure to complete the coding task. In order to quickly and accurately recommend high-quality code snippets for programmers, this paper Sentence-BERT model. Firstly, the method obtains a large amount of high-quality data to build the code base, and proposes a code snippet recommendation method based on generates sentence vectors with rich semantics for the natural language description corresponding to the code snippets and the natural language query input by users based on the deep learning model SBERT. Then, the code snippets are recommended by comparing the dot product similarity. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by comparing the three commonly used evaluation indexes of hit rate, average reciprocal ranking and average accuracy with the methods in the current related research. Experimental results show that this recommendation method can effectively improve the accuracy and effect of code snippet recommendation.

articleTitle: Research on Time-Space-Frequency Multi-Domain Conflict Detection Method for UAV Cluster Mission Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the time-space-frequency multi-domain conflict in making mission planning for large-scale UAVs, a time-space-frequency conflict decou-pling detection and resolution method based on systems Engineering V model was proposed. Firstly, the time-space-frequency conflict characteristics of UAVs mission planning are analyzed. Then, based on the systems engineering V model, a time-space-frequency conflict decoupling detection and resolution framework is constructed. On that basis, time-space-frequency multi-domain conflict resolution model for UAVs Mission Plan-ning is proposed by designing Terrain Model, Airspace Model, Time overlap Detection Model, elevation overlap detection model, 2-D overlap detection model, 2-D track overlap detection model, Space overlap detection model on same-frequency, etc. Finally, the simulation results show that the time-space-frequency conflict decoupling method based on system engineering V model has better advantages.

articleTitle: A Crawler Detection Method for The College Entrance Examination Information Website
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The college entrance examination information website provides users with a variety of college entrance examination data that can be used for reference. Due to the public nature of the website and the large scale of the data, it is vulnerable to attacks by web crawlers, which can threaten the stability of the website and the security of the data, so it is especially important to effectively control the crawlers on the college entrance examination information website. In this paper, we propose a crawler detection method for the college entrance examination information website. Firstly, we set multi-level access frequency thresholds to screen out users who may have crawling behavior, and then we detect and identify suspicious users' access according to the characteristics of college entrance examination information website crawlers by SVM, and finally identify the real web crawlers and prohibit them from accessing the college entrance examination information website. Through experiments, it is proved that this method can effectively detect a large part of crawlers and ensure the data security of the college entrance examination information website.

Author Keywords: the college entrance examination information website

articleTitle: Reparameterization of a Lightweight Network for Strawberry Flowers Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: An improved YOLO v4 with lightweight parameters was proposed to detect strawberry flowers in real-time. The improvement was accomplished through two strategies. Firstly, the backbone network was lightweight designed by replacing standard convolution with grouped convolution, under the Visual Geometry Group (VGG) and re-parameterization VGG (Rep-VGG) frameworks. Secondly, the backbone network was fused into a single branch after the training phase through reparameterization method. The experiment results shown that the improved algorithm was better than the original version in detection precision and speed, as well as memory footprint. Furthermore, the results also outperform the excellent object detection algorithms, including Faster R-CNN, SSD, YOLOX-s and EfficientDet. The proposed algorithm was suitable to be deployed on embedded platforms with limited computing power for strawberry flowers detection.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time SLAM Algorithm Based on ROS Node
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The intelligence of handling equipment plays an important role in improving the efficiency, systematization and informatization of production and logistics workshops, and this paper uses the improved visual SLAM algorithm to intelligently design logistics handling equipment for a universal logistics handling operation scenario, so that the handling equipment can have good environmental modeling ability and multi-target handling ability in complex operation workshop. Through the junction of ROS, all parts of the handling equipment can share information to ensure the future expansion performance of the equipment. A possible solution for algorithmic intelligence in handling equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Intention Recognition of Educational Counseling Combining BERT and Concept Map
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the process of building a question answering system, the intention recognition of questions is an important step, and the accuracy of intention recognition has a great impact on the question answering system. In this method, the concepts of each entity in the concept graph are explicitly applied to the data processing process, and the entities are abstracted into a concept level. At the same time, in order to distinguish the subtle differences between concepts, different concepts of the same entity are further scored and ranked, and the concepts are sequentially applied. Incorporating the information of the concept map into the classification model can significantly improve the accuracy of the model in the domain, so that the model still has a good effect on a small-scale training set. Finally, experiments are carried out on the data of question answering in the college entrance examination field. The experimental results show that the method has good effect and good generalization.

articleTitle: Research on Defect Segmentation Algorithm of Industrial Products Based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: For detecting surface defects of industrial products, especially on recognition accuracy and more detailed boundary recognition, an improved semantic segmentation model based on SegFormer network is put forward in this paper. In the decoder part of the model, the bi-directional feature pyramid network (BiFPN) structure is used to receive the multi-scale feature maps output from encoder, and semantic information between feature maps of different sizes are integrated. Then, the integrated semantic features are input to Boundary Refinement (BR) module to enhance Boundary information and enhance the final segmentation effect, so that the improved Segformer structure is better applicable to surface defect detection of industrial products.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Method of Major Hazard in Ammunition Depot Based on G1-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The ammunition depot is a typical man-machine-environment complex system, in which, man, machine (ammunition, dangerous goods, support equipment) environment and management (organization and leadership, thinking, implementation of laws and regulations, technology application, etc.) alternate and interact with each other. Based on the risk identification and classification of major hazard sources in ammunition depot, the paper constructs the risk assessment index system of major hazard sources in the aspects of personnel behavior, equipment and materials, storage environment and management level, the weight of each index is determined by G1 method, and the risk assessment of major hazard in ammunition depot is realized by combining the method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: TSN and 5G Integrated Network Cross-Domain Scheduling and Routing Method for Power Control Business
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the development of the energy Internet, the regulation scale of various control services of electric power is becoming more and more refined, and it is necessary to provide reliable communication support in an open and shared environment. Due to the advancement of Layer 2 Ethernet technology, power networks based on time-sensitive networking (TSN) functions have emerged, and 5G networks have been applied in more and more scenarios due to their low latency and high reliability technical characteristics. To this end, it provides end-to-end deterministic transmission guarantee across 5G and TSN. Real-time protection of power services such as power distribution automation, power consumption information collection, and intelligent power load control. In this paper, a cross-domain scheduling and routing method for control services is designed in a 5G+TSN network. Aiming at the problem of excessive scheduling overhead in power data transmission, a dynamic traffic balance management scheme based on mixed integer linear programming (MILP) was established for the first time. Next, this joint scheduling problem is solved by proposing an algorithm combining random and local search of multi-objective simulated annealing (called SA-JPRS algorithm), and finally it can be observed that the algorithm proposed in this study can effectively balance load balancing and Transfer These two power transfer metrics are compared to other systems through simulation to determine how fast or slow the latency is.

articleTitle: Overview of Distributed Task Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Under the background of big data how to more efficiently solve the problem of concurrency has always been a hot research problem. In this case, the distributed scheduling technology produces many new ideas and new structures. In this context, this paper introduces the task architecture and three scheduling techniques in big data environment.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition in Fire Control Texts Based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In order to extract named entities from fire control texts more accurately, a named entity corpus based on fire control related texts is constructed. Aiming at the traditional word vector or word vector can not better represent the context semantics and the disadvantages of recurrent neural network in using GPU parallel computing ability, a named entity recognition model of fire control related texts based on BERT is proposed. The word granularity vector matrix is obtained by using the BERT language model, and the use the IDCNN to abstract features from text. The text dependency on a long-distance of sentences is obtained through MA layer. At last, the global best sequence is extracted through CRF. By analyzing the final experimental findings, it is known that the accuracy, recall and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F$</tex> value increased 2.78%, 1.59% and 1.33% respectively.

articleTitle: Maintenance and Repair of Windshields for High Speed Multiple Units
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The article first analyzes the structure and composition of the windshield of the high-speed multiple unit, on this basis, it sorts out the main contents and implementation methods of the daily maintenance project of the windshield of the high-speed multiple unit, provides the troubleshooting process for water accumulation in the inner windshield, and finally introduces the implementation process and functional testing plan for the special maintenance of various components of the windshield of the high-speed multiple unit.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction Based on CEEMDAN-LSTM-LINREG Model
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In this paper, CEEMDAN is introduced to perform modal decomposition of indicator data to capture the characteristics of the data at different time scales. Each feature is constructed as a stacked LSTM sub-prediction model. Since different features represent different dimensions, the cumulative sum of the results of each sub-model as the final prediction result will lead to the problem of error superposition. In this paper, a linear regression model is introduced to self-learn the corresponding weights of each sub-model, and the weighted sum method is used to fuse the results of each sub-model to alleviate the error superposition problem. The dissolved oxygen, ammonia nitrogen, PH and permanganate indicators are taken as examples to verify the prediction model proposed in this paper. The experimental results show that in the models constructed by CEEMDAN and EMD decomposition algorithms, the prediction accuracy of each index is improved by 11.88%, 4.38%, 1.33%, 3.38 and 19.29%, 3.65%, 0.61 %, 2.65% respectively after introducing the linear regression model. It shows that the combined model constructed in this paper has strong generalization ability and robustness.

articleTitle: Application of Encryption Technology in Information Security of the Internet of Things Perception Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Because the IoT (Internet of things) perception layer has a large number of nodes, limited computing and storage capabilities, and complex data types and network types, attackers can attack the loT perception layer with devices with good endurance, computing and storage capabilities, thus threatening the security of the sensing environment. In this paper, the application of encryption technology in information security of loT perception layer is studied. In order to make up for the huge overhead problem faced by Server in the existing research, this paper introduces fog nodes and constructs a fog-assisted crowdsourcing task assignment and swarm intelligence perception data aggregation model. Using fog nodes to assist the sensing platform to achieve large-scale task allocation and data aggregation. In order to protect their data privacy, participants choose to encrypt the data before submitting the perceived data to the fog node. The simulation results show that the reading efficiency of this method is greatly improved compared with other existing methods. The non-monotonic jump of the throughput rate of each method is because the setting of the initial frame is more suitable for reading the number of tags in this method. Simulation results show the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Improved General Property Graphs Query Method Based on TinkerPop
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, knowledge graphs, which are an important part of many artificial intelligence technologies, have also begun to receive more and more attention. The current mainstream data models of knowledge graphs mainly include RDF graphs and property graphs. Although property graphs have multiple implementations, they lack a standard query language. This paper proposes an improved general query method for property graphs based on the general graph framework TinkerPop, which can use the standard query language SPARQL of RDF graph to query property graphs. This method improves the original module of TinkerPop and realizes ASK query and path query functions. At the end of the article, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method by conducting experimental comparisons on real-world air route graph data.

articleTitle: XGBoost-based alignment determination of rotation axis under leakage field
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Rotating shaft alignment detection is an important part of equipment inspection for large mechanical equipment. In view of the characteristics of the mechanical structure of rotating shaft alignment and the shortcomings of existing detection methods, this paper proposes a method for determining rotating shaft alignment under leakage magnetic field based on the XGBoost method. Specifically, the leakage magnetic field is formed at the rotating shaft connection by using leakage magnetic detection technology, and the position and distance of misalignment are predicted by picking up the leakage magnetic field information and handing it over to the model established by XGBoost method for judgment. The experiments show that the XGBoost method has good accuracy and superiority in judging the rotation axis alignment.

articleTitle: Network Adaptation Method for Ghost Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Ghost imaging (GI), as a new computational imaging method, has a great prospect of development. However, speckles that interact with objects may not be consistent with the measured due to interference in the propagation path. In recent years, deep learning (DL) methods have been more and more applied to GI. However, most neural networks are sensitive to speckle patterns change, which affects the reconstruction performance. In order to avoid the impact of patterns change on network performance, we here proposed a network adaptation method for GI patterns change. The experimental results show that the reconstruction performance of our method is similar to that without patterns change.

articleTitle: Medical Data Sharing Scheme Based on Blockchain-Based Attribute Proxy Re-Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Medical data is a kind of personal information with high value. In the traditional medical data management system, it is usually stored in a centralized database, which has problems such as single point of failure, invalid access policy, and difficulty in sharing. Aiming at the above problems, a blockchain-based medical data sharing scheme is proposed. First, use the consortium blockchain to ensure the integrity and transparency of medical data, and use the stealth address method to ensure the impossibility of doctor-patient contact, propose an attribute encryption and proxy re-encryption scheme with a hidden strategy to achieve fine-grained data Access Control Scheme. Combined with smart contracts, the revocation of access rights and the control of access time are realized to protect the privacy of patients. Secondly, in view of the problem of centralized single point of failure and the excessive load of blockchain storage in the process of data sharing, the solution is integrated with blockchain, smart contracts and interplanetary file systems to realize distributed storage of original data ciphertexts under the chain. Low overhead mode shared on-chain with key information ciphertext. Finally, through the security evaluation, it is proved that the scheme can guarantee the safe sharing of data. Through comparison with similar data sharing schemes and performance analysis experiments, the results show that this scheme has better efficiency under the premise of ensuring safe sharing.

articleTitle: Bi-Mapping Between RDF and Property Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The existing solutions of RDF mapping to Property Graph can only complete one-direction mapping, which leads to the difficulty of knowledge reuse in the domain of knowledge graph. This paper proposes a solution based on mapping structure to convert RDF to Property Graph, and compares it with Neosemantics from three aspects: computability, information preservation and semantic preservation. It is proved that the solution proposed in this paper has better universality and higher efficiency in the process of bidirectional mapping and improves the circulability and reusability of knowledge in the knowledge storage domain.

articleTitle: Construction of Sensitive Image Datasets Based on Generative Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Due to the special nature of sensitive information, available sensitive data resources are relatively scarce to meet the needs of research in this field. The purpose of this paper is to construct a large sensitive image dataset by generative methods, with a view to supporting research exploration in related aspects. To achieve this goal, we adopt a new idea. First, we crawl sensitive and non-sensitive class datasets from web pages and filter them manually. Here, the sensitive classes mainly involve violence, terror and pornography; second, the selected data are used as the training set to fine-tune the pre-trained generative model; then, the fine-tuned generative model is used for sensitive/non-sensitive image generation, which expands the training dataset; finally, the generated training set is passed into the classification model to do the classification task for result verification. The experimental results show that the classification results of the expanded dataset using the generative method are higher than those of the original dataset, which proves the effectiveness of the generative method to construct the dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Faster R-CNN in Stacked Artifact Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In order to improve the sorting efficiency of workpieces, improve the sorting quality, reduce the labor intensity of workers and improve the working environment, and at the same time meet the needs of small batch, multi-variety and mixed production, this paper studies the improvement of Faster R-CNN for the field of robotic sorting. Application in stacked workpiece recognition. This paper improves the Faster R-CNN and proposes the Bin-Soft-NMS algorithm based on the Soft-NMS algorithm. The dynamic threshold is used to improve the low recall rate of the model and the low score of the adjacent stacked workpiece bounding box caused by the inaccurate threshold. the problem of inhibition. A stacked workpiece dataset was made by using four kinds of workpieces, and the model was trained on the dataset to complete the experiment. The experimental results show that the average detection accuracy of the improved model in the stacked workpiece scene is 86.26%, and the improvement in mild, moderate and severe scenarios is improved respectively. increased by 1.0%, 3.2% and 4.825%, with an average increase of 3%.

articleTitle: P2P Traffic Identification under Dual Protocol Stack Based on the C4.5 Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: P2P (peer-to-peer) technology is widely used in the internet, so the research on identifying P2P traffic has always been a hot topic. However, in the past, the identification of P2P traffic was only limited to pure IPv4 networks. In the global trend of promoting the deployment of IPv6, universities are in the stage of transition to an IPv6 network environment, where IPv4 and IPv6 will coexist for a long time. Currently, there is a lack of research on the identification of P2P traffic in this complex dual stack environment. To address the limitations of traditional recognition methods that cannot detect encrypted traffic and manually determine popular feature thresholds, this article adopts the C4.5 decision tree algorithm in machine learning, selecting the proportion of upstream and downstream traffic, the degree of discreteness of packet size, and the length of flow connection as sample features, collecting data traffic in a real university dual stack network environment to identify P2P traffic under both IPv4 and IPv6 links. The experimental results show that this method can effectively identify P2P traffic under IPv4 and IPv6, with an average accuracy of over 95%.

articleTitle: Realization of Flexible Scaling Technology for Computing Tasks in Power Automation System Based on Container
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the popularization and construction of the new power system, the amount of data to be processed by the power automation system will increase explosively, and the original mode of main and standby machines will no longer meet the demand. At present, some dynamic scheduling algorithms studied in the industry do not consider the security, reliability and real-time requirements of power system. By studying the characteristics of some existing scheduling algorithms and the implementation principle of container technology, this paper proposes a container based elastic scaling technology for computing tasks, which can dynamically adjust the resources of each application instance without affecting the resource use of other application instances. At the same time, it supports highly reliable mutual redundancy and real-time switching, and supports the real-time elastic expansion of resources after adding new nodes. Finally, through the test and verification, the technology can support the dynamic allocation and distributed operation of power application resources, switch the active and standby computers in real time in case of failure, support the elastic expansion of resources, and improve the reliability and processing capacity of the upper application.

articleTitle: Improved Polar Decoder Based on Modular Neural Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the wide application of Deep Neural Network (DNN) in the field of communication, this technique has also been applied in the coding and decoding technology, but there are few neural network structures with good performance in the decoder. This paper proposes a new polar code decoding network structure, which uses a modular network structure to train the empirical parameters in the iterative belief propagation (BP) algorithm model. The experiment part uses the new structure to implement scaling min-sum (SMS) algorithm and offset min-sum (OMS) algorithm. Through comparing the performance of the above algorithms with the traditional structure, it is found that the new structure has the advantages of better bit error rate (BER) and faster convergence performance compared with the traditional network structure.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis of Digital Music Resources Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the rapid growth of Internet, the problem of data overload has become increasingly prominent. In this article, a digital music resource recommendation model combining deep learning (DL) and collaborative filtering (CF) algorithm is proposed to mine the characteristics of users' music preferences, so that the recommendation system can accurately and effectively reflect users' personal preferences, and adjust according to users' preferences to achieve individualization recommendations for different users. The simulation results show that the accuracy of this music resource recommendation algorithm is improved by 24.64% compared with the traditional recommendation method. This model can not only extract time series features, but also be lightweight and high performance, and can more accurately classify songs for subsequent recommendation models.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Distribution Network Dispatching Operation Based on Digital Twinning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the electric distribution grid, the access of distributed electric power generation also brings new technical challenges. From the perspective of operation, after the distributed generation is related to the electric distribution grid, due to the uncertainty of wind energy, solar energy and other new energy, there will be higher harmonics in the distribution network that affect the power quality and power supply reliability. On the other hand, it is necessary to consider the economic cost and reasonably distribute the output status of different units in the distribution network to achieve the unity of economic and ecological benefits. While, it has occasion to research the dispatching method of electric distribution grid with distributed generation. This paper uses digital twinning technology to build virtual equipment modeling scheme, which integrates equipment basic data, system single line diagram and grid geographic coordinate data. With rapid processing governance as the core and electric grid topology computing function, it realizes the whole process management of electric distribution grid dispatching and management, and provides production management personnel with distribution network digital simulation platform and auxiliary decision-making function.

articleTitle: Improved Bacteria Feeding Algorithm Which Based on Adaptive Probability
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The bacterial foraging algorithm is a new bionic algorithm with good performance in big data scheduling [4]. However, the traditional bacterial foraging algorithm has room for further improvement in the expressiveness of the algorithm because of the fixed step size and fixed action. Based on the traditional bacterial foraging algorithm, combined with the relevant requirements of big data scheduling, this paper further discusses and improves the performance of the bacterial foraging algorithm. Experiments show that the improved bacterial foraging algorithm has good performance in performance and response time compared with traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Implementation of IEEE1588 Protocol Based on STM32H750
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the industrial control field, multiple nodes in the network need to collect and process data cooperatively. However, due to the lack of clock synchronization capability of the network, the data lacks time series information, which will lead to the abnormal fusion processing of multiple data by the upper computer, In the system, IEEE1588 protocol (accurate clock synchronization protocol of network measurement and control system) is used to solve the above problems. Based on the development board with STM32H750 microcontroller as the core, a distributed clock synchronization system is built. The system has built a LwIP (Light Weight TCP/IP Stack) network protocol stack to realize the transmission of various messages during clock synchronization, The time jitter delay from the transmission layer of the network protocol stack to the framing of the data link layer is eliminated, and the accuracy of clock synchronization is improved. The experimental results show that the system can achieve nanosecond level clock synchronization, and can be used in industrial control sites that require high real-time performance.

articleTitle: A Workshop Safety Inspection Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: As an important branch of machine vision, video surveillance has been playing a vital role in traffic, security, monitoring and other fields. Especially driven by the development of deep learning and intelligent manufacturing, the monitoring field has become more and more intelligent and refined. However, some production scenarios still use traditional monitoring methods so far, relying too much on manual watch, and it is impossible to achieve real-time and effective alarm and feedback for abnormal behaviors on the production site. Based on this, this paper designs an intelligent security monitoring model for abnormal behaviors in the industrial scene based on deep learning technology, extracts effective features from the video and represents the target, detects violations or unsafe behaviors in the video in real time, and gives timely feedback to improve the intelligence of the industrial production management system and ensure production safety.

articleTitle: Simulation of Traditional Culture Communication Model Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Traditional culture is the treasure of China's cultural field. In the new era, it is of great significance to make traditional culture glow with new vitality. Media integration provides technical support for the integration of China traditional culture into modern cultural context and usage scenarios. With the advantages of rapid, stable and sustainable development of information technology, it is an important task for researchers engaged in information technology in universities for nationalities to develop information products or systems suitable for the characteristics of national traditional culture and realize the protection, inheritance and development of national traditional culture. From the perspective of the combination of big data and traditional culture, this paper will build a communication model of traditional culture based on deep neural network, and study and discuss the new development of traditional culture in the new era. Through big data technology, traditional culture can have better communication channels, let more people feel the profound connotation and humanistic feelings of traditional culture, and promote the inheritance and promotion of traditional culture.

articleTitle: Magnetic Flux Leakage Image Detection in Axial Alignment Based on ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The state detection of shaft alignment is an important industrial problem, and the magnetic flux leakage data set of shaft alignment state can be established by using the magnetic flux leakage detection technology. Aiming at the question of whether there is parallel deviation and angle deviation in the shaft alignment problem, this paper proposes an improved ResNet model that can be used to detect the shaft alignment state. Firstly, the ANSYS simulation software is used to establish a shaft alignment state model, and then the shaft alignment magnetic flux leakage data sets under different parallel deviations and angle deviations are simulated. Finally, an algorithm that can be used for shaft alignment state detection is designed based on the ResNet model. Among MFL data, axial MFL data, radial MFL data and circumferential MFL data are of different importance to axial parallel deviation and angular deviation. In this paper, self-attention mechanism is introduced to learn the importance of different channels to solve this problem. At the same time, the Stacking method is used to integrate the improved ResNet model with the Xception model, which improves the accuracy and versatility of the algorithm. Finally, the accuracy of the model is verified by experiments, as well as the influence of different steel materials and excitation strengths on the improved algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can achieve an accuracy rate of 96.14% in the detection of the shaft alignment state, and has good versatility for different specifications of steel.

articleTitle: Design Method of Component-Based Party Building Visualization Large-screen System
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of long development period, tedious development of multiple views, high update and maintenance costs, the paper proposes the design method of party construction visualization large screen based on componentization and builds a party construction data visualization system. In this paper, we take the party construction data of a university in Hebei Province as an example, firstly, we describe the basic process of data processing and visualization, then we describe the componentized way to build the chart components applicable to the party construction scenario, and finally we propose a “V-C” (Views-Components) component interaction method for to improve the interactivity of the multi-view visualization screen. The interactivity of the large visualization screen. Through testing, the system has a friendly interface, easy to operate, and convenient to build a large visualization screen for party building data, which is convenient to understand the dynamics of daily party building work in time and play a role in reminding and warning.

articleTitle: A Multi-Model Fusion Method for Remaining Engine Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The engine is crucial for the safe flight of aircraft. Its health condition affects the safety of passengers to some extent. To improve the accuracy of the remaining engine life prediction, this paper proposes a remaining engine life prediction model founded on a combination of a convolutional neural network, a time-domain convolutional network, and a triggered cyclic unit of the Inception module. First, we regularized the data and fed it into the multi-model fusion remaining useful life prediction model. And the normalized data is processed by CNN to The LSTM extracts the timedomain feature information and thus effectively extracts the state feature information, thus more accurately representing the degraded state of the equipment. In this paper, the CMAPSS public dataset uses to forecast the remaining life cycle of the engine, and it was also compared with the Bi-LSTM and CNNLSTM models, which have improved the prediction accuracy in some ways.

articleTitle: Construction of Automobile Consumer Evaluation Model Based on Data Mining Algorithm under the Background of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The emergence of the new economic model, the continuous development and application of high technology, and its penetration into the consumption field have led to many new changes in consumer behavior. Mastering the changing trend of consumer behavior plays an important role in developing production, invigorating circulation and guiding consumption. The automobile distribution industry has accumulated a lot of data, including industry information, customer information and so on. These data are important references for the market operation of automobile dealers. Based on the background of digital transformation, this article constructs a prediction model of automobile consumers' purchasing behavior based on data mining algorithm. From the test results, it can be seen that this algorithm is more accurate in predicting automobile consumers' consumption tendency, which is 20.11% higher than the traditional ID3 algorithm. The research method of this article is applied to the database of automobile distribution enterprises, so that dealers can make more accurate quantitative analysis and scientific prediction, which is helpful to improve their market competitiveness.

articleTitle: PLR-Based Heat Treatment Process State Identification Method
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In industrial production, the heat treatment process has a variety of forms, but the most basic process is the thermal process, it includes heating, insulation and cooling three stages. According to the importance of temperature and data characteristics in heat treatment industry, the pretreatment operation of data from dimensionality reduction, interpolation, normalization and feature representation of time series data were studied, and a method of temperature state recognition of heat treatment process based on piecewise linear representation was proposed. In this method, the change point of temperature data sequences was extracted by the deviation degree change between temperature data, and the initial temperature data was divided into trend segments based on this method. Then, the trend segments were merged by the top-down algorithm to obtain the overall trend feature representation of the original data. According to the statistical characteristics of the data, the classifier is trained with RNN characteristics, and the processing state of the heat treatment process is finally obtained. Based on the actual temperature data of a heat treatment unit, experiments were carried out to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Data Center Traffic Rescheduling Algorithm Based on Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The state of the data center network is constantly changing. When a large amount of burst traffic occurs, local congestion may occur on some network links, affecting not only network performance but also delay-sensitive small traffic. A traffic rescheduling strategy based on ant colony optimization algorithm is proposed. Based on SDN technology, periodic load detection is carried out on network links to discover congestion links in time. Then, the ant colony optimization algorithm is used to select the transmission path with light load for the data stream that occupies the most bandwidth on the congestion, and the possibility of link congestion is reduced by rescheduling. Finally, the simulation delay proves that the algorithm can improve the network performance and service quality.

articleTitle: Attention-LSTM-Based Prediction Model of PM2.5 Hourly Concentration
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: As an important indicator to measure the concentration of air pollutants, the monitoring and prediction of PM2.5 concentration can effectively protect the atmospheric environment and further reduce the harm caused by air pollution. With the large-scale establishment of automatic air quality monitoring stations, the air quality prediction model built by traditional machine learning can no longer meet the current needs. In this paper, an attention-LSTM model based on Long Short Term Memory network (LSTM) and multi-head attention mechanism is proposed to predict PM2.5 hourly concentration, and the data from a monitoring station in Shenyang are trained and tested. This model takes into account the influence of PM2.5 concentration on other air quality data, uses the two-layer LSTM network to capture the complex time series correlation features between air quality data, and uses the multi-head attention mechanism to extract the time series correlation features of different subspaces, which can obtain more complete and effective characteristic information. Experiments prove that compared with mainstream air quality prediction methods such as ARIMA, AutoEncoder and LSTM, the Attention-LSTM model proposed in this paper effectively improves the prediction accuracy and can accurately predict PM2.5 concentration.

articleTitle: Web-Based Optimization and Expansion of Multimodal High School Entrance Examination Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The reform of the new college entrance examination system makes students and their parents pay more attention to the feasibility and accuracy of the college entrance examination. The college entrance examination informatization can help the local admissions departments to mine and analyze the data rules from the massive college entrance examination data, and provide help and guidance for each link of volunteer application. Therefore, this paper, in order to comply with the development trend of the new college entrance examination information construction, proposes the optimization method of data visualization chart rendering and innovative combination of ideas to improve the Web rendering performance in order to enhance the interactive experience of users and the platform.

articleTitle: A Data Driven Digital Twin Visualization Method for Motion Control
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the interaction and fusion of digital space and physical space in digital twin system, a data driven digital twin visualization method for motion control is proposed. OPC UA protocol is adopted to realize data acquisition, and the disconnection reconnection mechanism is added to deal with emergencies; The acquisition time frequency is determined to ensure the smooth movement of the twin model, and the real-time data persistence operation is realized to facilitate the inverse time analysis of historical data; Realize the motion constraint of the twin model, add the parent-child hierarchical relationship between the motion limit constraint and the components of the equipment model, ensure that the twin model conforms to the real physical properties, and realize the motion drive, including coordinate movement, rotation, clamping, etc; The reverse time replication service is realized by adding data smoothing and other functions. The feasibility of the method is verified on the NC machine tool test bed and the stacking robot, which provides a practical basis for the method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Domestic Garbage Classification System Based on Deep Learning Model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Garbage classification is a very important subject for human beings. Garbage classification can make more efficient use of resources. With the rapid improvement of computing power, people began to use deep learning technology to solve problems in various fields. Currently, the existing garbage classification models have various disadvantages such as insufficient accuracy and low real-time performance. To solve these problems, this paper uses the dataset from Huawei Cloud Garbage Classification AI Contest, and enhances the dataset by cutting and adding random noise. On the grounds of previous studies, this paper optimizes the ResNext-50 model by including an attention mechanism. While improving accuracy of a single model reach the bottleneck, the improved ResNext-50 model is merged with the EfficientNet-B4 model. Bayesian optimization is selected when the parameters are fused, significantly increasing the effectiveness of the search. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the model reaches 93.36%. Compared with the existing garbage classification model, this model has achieved a certain improvement in accuracy. In this paper, the optimized model is deployed on the server, and a client program based on Android is developed. The efficiency of garbage classification is considerably increased by the ability of users to take images of various sorts of trash and identify them.

articleTitle: Rendering Optimization of Massive Map Annotation Point Data Based on Multi Strategy Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor visualization effect and system lag delay caused by the rendering of massive map label points, an optimization strategy combining visual optimization technology and point aggregation algorithm is proposed, and it is officially put into use in a city and town pavement collapse monitoring visualization platform. Compared with the traditional annotation point optimization scheme, firstly, the annotation point classification processing according to the specific business scenario, asynchronous traversal of data combined with documentFragment and other optimization technologies, combined with the K-D tree-based Grid-Distance-based Clustering, by comparing the performance report detected by Google LightHouse, the performance indicators in the page display are improved by about 26%. At the same time, in terms of optimization effect, the number of callout points rendered on the page is controlled, so that the number of reflow redraws caused by page rendering is further reduced.

articleTitle: TALCLIP: CLIP for Temporal Action Localization
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: For regulators of online live streaming and short video platforms, the problem of producing and disseminating soft pornographic videos is becoming serious. For online cultural market supervision, it is a challenging and high-value task to detect and locate soft pornographic temporal regions in videos of live streaming and short video platforms. We present a dataset about Video Frame-Danmaku Dataset containing soft pornographic information based on the Bilibili Danmaku Website. On the task of temporal action localization for soft pornographic video clips, we use the multi-modal model (CLIP) to extract video features and text features. Meanwhile we use the prompt mechanism to convert the danmaku which is splicing similar danmaku in the same release time into labels. Finally, we use a boundary-matching network to get the start and end positions containing soft pornographic information on Bilibili Video-Danmaku Dataset and containing specified action on ActivityNet-1.3.

articleTitle: Improved K-Prototype Clustering Algorithm for Plant-Side of Power Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: On the plant side of the power monitoring system, in order to achieve non-destructive and lightweight vulnerability inventory thus proposing cluster analysis, the target assets are clustered, and the impact on the plant-side hosts during vulnerability inventory is greatly reduced through the optimization of the scanning strategy. The asset information collected by the scan is processed to obtain a hybrid dataset. Using the improved k-prototypes clustering algorithm to cluster the target assets, and according to the clusters of hosts with different functions obtained by clustering, an optimized scanning strategy is adopted to change the scanning behavior and reduce the impact caused to the target network. The improvement of the clustering algorithm is mainly reflected in the initial category center selection and distance calculation. For the initial category center selection, the phase dissimilarity measure is adopted for the initial category center selection; in the distance calculation, the entropy weight value is introduced to change the traditional method of randomly determining the attribute weights, which avoids the local optimum and improves the stability of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Algorithm in Complex Environment Based on Improved SOLOV2
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Previous industrial robots combined with vision systems in target grasping tasks have high requirements for the task environment. Once the vision system is confronted with a target object in a complex environment such as stacking, tilting and occlusion, it will be difficult to provide the robot control system with the correct target pose information due to the lack of target feature information, which is not conducive to the dynamic configuration capability of the production system. This study proposes an industrial target image segmentation algorithm based on improved SOLOv2 to solve the problem of low accuracy of industrial target image segmentation caused by small targets as well as occlusion. Building upon the SOLOv2 model, the optimization of fusing multi-layer features within the mask feature branch is deaigned to integrate feature information from the deepest to the shallowest layers, in a layer-by-layer manner; the Mish activation function is selected in the upsampling process to enhance the model's ability to extract small target features in images while improving the generalization ability and convergence speed of the model; to mitigate the impact of occlusion on image segmentation, the weights of the loss function are adaptively adjusted based on the degree of occlusion. This allows for a reduction in the negative influence of occlusion on image segmentation, as the loss function is optimezed to account for varying degrees of occlusion.

articleTitle: Construction Method of Power Knowledge Map Based on Deep neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the increasing demand for automation and efficiency of the power grid, the power industry needs to accelerate the pace of building a highly intelligent and intelligent platform. However, the power operation and maintenance knowledge base for the professional model field is different from the common knowledge bases on the market. Some conventional application technologies cannot be used directly. The technical difficulties and practical business problems faced by the power operation and maintenance knowledge base in real scenarios are still not very good. solution. This paper uses technologies such as natural language processing, combined with deep neural network models, to construct a set of portable and easy-to-retrieve power knowledge graphs through knowledge extraction, knowledge fusion, knowledge reasoning and other technologies.

articleTitle: Analysis of China's Blockchain Technology Innovation Situation Based on Patent Metrology
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Conventional patent metrics may not provide an accurate assessment of a technology's actual level of development. To address this issue, this study utilizes metrological research methods to perform empirical analysis on global blockchain technology-related patent applications. Based on the findings, the study provides suggestions to governments and companies on how to enhance China's innovative capabilities in the blockchain technology field. In this paper, the incoPat patent search database and information visualization tools are employed to scrutinize the patent application trends, technical application fields, and innovation trends. Furthermore, the Herfindahl-Hirschman index is utilized to measure and examine the patent concentration of blockchain technology patent applicants across various regions of China. The analysis shows that China has the highest number of patent applications in the field of blockchain technology. However, the percentage of high-value patents is relatively low, which requires further improvement. Patent distribution in the eastern region of China is more dispersed, while the western region has more concentrated patents. The government should issue differentiated policies based on geographic location to avoid excessive concentration or dispersion of patents.

articleTitle: An Algorithm Model of Power Grid Maintenance Ticket Based on Bert
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: A variety of semantic instructions are needed to implement operations in the daily operation of the grid. Among them, maintenance ticket language is the most important one among all grid semantics. However, because the semantic recognition of maintenance ticket is implemented in a strong scenario like power distribution network, there are problems such as low recognition efficiency and misclassification of recognition results. In this paper, we propose to use BERT algorithm model with Bi-LSTM and CRF to form a new type of algorithm model, and on this basis, we propose to improve the structure of the algorithm model. Finally, it is experimentally shown that not only can the algorithm improve the recognition effect of each classification, but also can give better overall recognition effect.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Timing Job Scheduling System for Data Analysis Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The data analysis platform provides the ability of real-time analysis of big data and accelerates the application of big data in production. In order to solve a series of timing problems existing in the data analysis platform, this paper designs a distributed timing job scheduling system oriented to the data analysis platform. The system adopts centerless Master-Worker architecture. It includes five functional modules: job management, job scheduling, job execution, log management, and worker node monitoring. The system supports scheduled jobs and broadcast jobs in segments. It supports a variety of job scheduling strategies and collects job execution logs in real time. Applying it to the data analysis platform can greatly facilitate job management and reduce job execution time.

articleTitle: Inversion and Prediction of Carbon Emissions Based on Remote Sensing Data and BP-XGBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In this paper, we first use the BP model optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO) to integrate DMSP-OLS nighttime light data and NPP-VIIRS nighttime light data to establish a long-time series of nighttime light data sets were obtained. And using the integrated nighttime light data, temperature data and geographical data, based on the Bayesian optimization algorithm (BO) optimized XGBoost model, a carbon dioxide emission prediction model was constructed. In this study, the dataset based on nighttime light data shows a significant positive correlation to carbon emissions. As a result, the dataset can be used to estimate carbon emissions. And when using the BO-XGBoost model to invert carbon emissions, the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is 0.9791, and the RMSE is 29.9118, which is the most accurate predictive outcome compared to other models. The results of this study will help simplify the work of carbon emission accounting and provide an important basis for regional carbon emission policies.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Fast Start and Recovery of CNC System Based on AM335x
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Based on AM335x processor, this paper completes the fast start and recovery function of CNC system. This function is implemented in Uboot, using MTD technology to partition Nand Flash, configure serial port, LCD, USB and other pin clocks, and modify and add functions that check and update USB files. Finally, the Uboot transplanted on AM335x in this paper shortens the startup time of the CNC system, provides an LCD boot interface, and realizes the function of quickly restoring the CNC system from the U disk.

articleTitle: Application of Seq2Seq Model Based on TCN-GRU to Multivariate Water Quality Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Water pollution is still a common problem worldwide and needs to be solved urgently. Accurately predict changes in water quality can help decision makers better solve water pollution problems. However, water quality data are characterized by uncertainty, nonlinearity and complexity, the existing water quality prediction models have low prediction accuracy and poor generalization ability. In this paper, a seq2seq multivariate water quality prediction model combining TCN model, GRU model and self-attention mechanism is proposed. The traditional seq2seq model based on the basic architecture of recurrent neural network has limited ability to extract features, and it is difficult to effectively process large-scale multivariate water quality data. We use the TCN model as the encoder and the GRU model as the decoder, so as to effectively use the nonlinear feature processing capability of TCN model for time series data and the nonlinear fitting ability of the GRU model. In addition, we add a self-attention mechanism to the decoder, so that the model can effectively extract hidden related factors that affect water quality changes, further improved the predictive power of the model. To demonstrate the predictive power of the TCN-GRU seq2seq model, we conduct an experimental study on a real river water quality dataset, Experiments show that our model achieves optimal prediction results.

articleTitle: SAFD: A Statistical Analysis-Based Feature Point Descriptor
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Describing and matching feature points is one of the most basic tasks in many computer vision tasks. For example, in tasks such as structure from motion, simultaneous localization and mapping, and image stitching, the quality of feature point matching directly determines the accuracy of the vision task, which in turn affects the availability of specific applications such as VR, MR, autonomous driving, and robot navigation. The current mainstream feature point method has the problem that the number of mismatches is relatively large, which will cause a lot of interference to computer vision tasks based on feature point matching. Traditional feature point descriptors only use the feature point and very little information in its neighborhood, so mismatches are prone to occur. The main contribution of this paper is to propose a feature point descriptor and a corresponding matching method. The core idea is to use multiple dimensions of information to describe a feature point, and then integrate the differences in each dimension to evaluate the similarity between the two feature points, and then improve the matching rate of feature points. The experimental results show that the feature description and matching algorithm proposed in this paper is superior to the popular ORB algorithm in terms of matching rate.

articleTitle: Research on Power Voice Based on WaveNet+LSTM Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the rapid development of speech recognition [1] in recent years, the WaveNet model has also been discovered by more people and applied to speech recognition. In the open source LJSpeech-1.0, AISHELL and thch-30 and other general speech datasets, the model has achieved relatively good recognition results, but in the face of a large number of power voice data, because of the uniqueness and complexity of industry speech, the model is generally performed, so in this paper we have made some improvements to the model, aiming to improve the recognition of power-related speech data. First of all, in view of the shortcomings of the WaveNet network model in power speech recognition, we have improved and optimized it. The output gate structure of the LSTM network model is used to increase the nonlinearity of the model, so as to optimize the structural composition of the new model. We then introduced the core structure of The Reduced Convolution in WaveNet. According to the length of speech in the electric speech dataset, the receptive field of this structure is adjusted, and the sensory field is theoretically analyzed in order to better analyze the speech data. Finally, we experimentally verify the feasibility of applying the improved WaveNet model on the thch-30 dataset and the power-related dataset, and evaluate the trained model.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Cognitive Wireless Network Based on Multi-Relay Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the explosive growth of 5G wireless communication services, In this paper, NOMA technology and multiple relay selection technology are applied to cognitive radio networks in order to achieve large-scale connection and high reliability scenarios. The closed solutions of interrupt probabilities of different relay selection methods in the networks are calculated respectively, and the authenticity of the calculated results is verified by Monte the Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Construction of Music Popular Trend Prediction Model Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In this paper, a prediction model of music pop trend based on big data algorithm is proposed, and the approximate representation method of time series symbol aggregation based on starting and ending distance is used to predict music pop trend. This method puts forward a new distance measure by combining the symbolic distance and the starting and ending distance, which solves the problem that it is impossible to measure the consistency of symbols in each sequence segment, fully reflects the distance between time series, and effectively improves the effect of distance measurement. The research results show that the average song playing amount is better than the original song playing amount. The F value of the model predicted in this paper is 5064. It is superior to other time series music trend prediction models. Experiments show that this paper uses the approximate representation method of time series symbol aggregation based on the distance from beginning to end to predict the music fashion trend, which solves the problem of predicting the amount of songs played in the research of music fashion trend prediction and the problem of inaccurate prediction caused by the sudden increase of the amount of music data.

articleTitle: Research on Power Dispatching Speech Recognition Based on Improved Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Now, speech recognition [1] has developed rapidly. Transformer network model architecture is constructed by encoder and decoder. has become popular and applied to speech recognition. The Transformer model has achieved very good results in ordinary daily scenes. In the production environment of power dispatching, speech recognition requires low error rate and faster recognition speed. Therefore, some improvements have been made to the Transformer model. Then, the core attention mechanism in Transformer is mainly introduced. According to the characteristics of voice dataset in power dispatching, the model is improved and the attention mechanism is lightweight. Finally, through experimental training, we use the improved model to train on the power dispatching voice dataset, and then evaluate the trained model.

articleTitle: A Sensitive Image Generation Method Based on Improved PatchGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of less data and unbalanced number of sensitive image samples in the deep learning task of sensitive image detection, this paper proposes a sensitive image generation method SI-GAN based on improved PatchGAN. The SI-GAN generator uses the DUD module, and uses the concat method to increase the number of channels of the feature map in the quantitative dimension, which improves the generation ability of the generator. The SI-GAN discriminator uses the RBL module to improve PatchGAN, extract more advanced feature information, and increase the discriminant's discriminative ability. The experimental results show that SI-GAN has better results in terms of generated image quality. The FID value of SI-GAN is 5.87 lower than that of PatchGAN. The IS value of SI-GAN is 5.09 more than PatchGAN. The SI-GAN proposed in this paper is able to optimize the quality of the generated images and generate images with more details.

articleTitle: Study on Application of VR Technology in Teaching Tourism Management Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the development of VR technology and related technology, the application of this technology in the teaching of higher education courses is becoming more and more widespread. In the current environment, many higher education schools are constantly changing and innovating their teaching models and teaching concepts in the hope of providing students with better teaching resources and teaching experiences. Many courses in tourism management are highly practical. By using relevant virtual reality technology in tourism courses, it helps to create a multi-dimensional teaching environment, deepen students' learning experience and enhance their practical skills. This paper analyzes the current shortcomings and difficulties of the teaching methods of tourism in higher education schools, and analysis the positive significance of VR technology applied to the teaching of tourism courses for improving the above problems. This provides some useful ideas for the enrichment of teaching tools and the improvement of teaching quality in tourism courses.

articleTitle: Translation-Equivalence-Based Unsupervised Ghost Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Ghost imaging (GI), as a burgeoning imaging technology, has gained a lot of attention in the past few years.
