To achieve better reconstructed image quality at low sampling rates, deep learning is introduced to GI. While supervised learning is widely used in GI, unsupervised learning also deserves to be studied in depth as it does not need real labeled images to train a network. Following this idea, we proposed a translation equivalence ghost imaging (TEGI) method only based on unlabeled bucket signals. A new loss function is designed to do unsupervised learning. It is demonstrated that our TEGI method can reconstruct target images with better quality than the differential ghost imaging method at low sampling rates.

articleTitle: Abnormal Data Detection Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Detection of abnormal nodes in wireless sensor networks is a key step to ensure the accuracy and reliability of network data, and the accuracy of data is an important index to measure the performance of wireless sensor networks. Detection of abnormal data is a key problem and major challenge faced by wireless sensor networks. Due to the lack of infrastructure and openness in space, wireless sensor networks can easily eavesdrop, intercept, forge and tamper with data. Because of the particularity of sensor node deployment area, the attacker may destroy or crack the captured node itself. Due to the small number of sensors, it is impossible to detect data anomalies by mining the spatial data correlation between sensors and their neighboring sensors. An anomaly detection method for wireless sensor networks based on time series data is proposed. On the other hand, in order for the base station to make accurate judgment, it is necessary for the sensor nodes to transmit reliable data values. Therefore, it is necessary to detect and eliminate abnormal data caused by noise or internal errors of sensor nodes in the network. The performance of the algorithm is analyzed theoretically, and the experimental evaluation is carried out based on the real large-scale wireless sensor network system data. The results show that the algorithm has high accuracy and effectively reduces the network communication overhead.

articleTitle: A Vein Segmentation Method Based on Improved U-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Recently, medical research has revealed that diffusion weighted imaging (DWI) is less sensitive than susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI) for acute ischemic stroke. Brain vein analysis in SWI is very important for personalised therapy, quantitative diagnosis, and prognosis of acute ischemic stroke. Therefore, the accurate segmentation of veins in SWI images has important significance in supplementary diagnosis and medical research. However, vein segmentation in SWI is a challenging task because different veins show distinct variability and uneven intensity and are difficult to manually split. This paper proposes an improvement method based on U-net, by using dense connection and mixing loss function, the best Dice coefficient and the ASSD were obtained by other comparison methods. The method presented in this article can be used as a potential tool to accurately measure SWI cerebral veins and help physicians in decision making.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Secure Transmission Architecture for IIOT Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the wave of digital economy sweeping the world, 5G, artificial intelligence, big data technology, cloud computing and other emerging technologies continue to integrate with industry to accelerate the development of industrial Internet. As an important strategy of traditional industrial digital transformation, industrial Internet of Things plays an important role in today's social development. However, the data transmission security of industrial equipment in the Internet of Things has been facing severe challenges. At present, most of the industrial Internet of Things adopt centralized architecture for equipment access authentication and industrial data transmission. Coupled with the poor industrial field application environment, equipment is difficult to resist malicious attacks. Centralized authentication institutions and data transmission may cause the abuse of power of trusted institutions and the acquisition and tampering of data by third parties, resulting in data transmission security problems. In this paper, combined with blockchain technology and MQTT protocol based on TLS, a data security transmission architecture for industrial IoT is proposed to ensure the safety of equipment access and data transmission in industrial IoT.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Enhanced Partial Discharge Photoelectric Sensing Technology Based on UV Fluorescent Photoconductor
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In this paper, from the perspective of enhancing the partial discharge photodetection efficiency, Dy<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped fluorescent glass are used as front-end coupling photoconductors to enhance the detection efficiency in the UV spectral band of the discharge, and a broad spectrum and high sensitivity partial discharge photodetection is achieved by matching the fluorescent photoconductors with single photon devices. In the study, the excitation spectra and fluorescence spectral properties of the two fluorescent photoconductors were compared and analyzed, and their matching efficiency with silicon photomultiplier and photomultiplier tube was calculated.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Completion Algorithm Based On Multimodal Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the existing multi-modal knowledge graph, the entity picture datasets have irrelevant pictures, resulting in noise of knowledge representation learning. Therefore, this paper proposes to use the image filtering algorithm to remove the entity irrelevant pictures in the picture datasets to improve the quality of datasets, and use the image enhancement algorithm to improve the number of pictures in the picture datasets. In this paper, the pretrained-model Bert was used to extract the text features, the pretrained-model CLIP was used to extract the image features, and the modal fusion algorithm was used to get the final representation of the triples. In addition, for textual and visual feature fusion, this paper proposes a multi-lavel residual network features fusion algorithm, and uses the public dataset FB15K-237 to test the proposed knowledge completion algorithm (MMKGR) based on multimodal knowledge representation learning. After comparing with other multimodal knowledge completion algorithms,as TransE, VisualBERT_base,IKRL and TransAE the algorithm proposed in this paper is superior to other algorithms in Hit@1, Hit@10 and MR.

articleTitle: An Attention-Based Entity Linking Method for Chinese Knowledge Base Question Answering System
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Entity linking for knowledge base question answering is the process of identifying entities in the question and linking them to knowledge base entities. There are some problems in entity linking of Chinese knowledge base question answering, such as missing context information, unclear word boundaries, and too many colloquialized words. We propose an attention-based entity linking method. In the candidate entity generation stage, we use various ways to generate candidate entities. In the candidate entity disambiguation stage, attention mechanism is introduced to highlight the features that are more critical for entity disambiguation. We conduct experiments on public data sets, and the results show the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: A Quality Control Model for Lung Cancer Based on A Standardized Treatment Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the medical field, quality of care is one of the most important goals, and only by achieving good quality of care can we provide better health services to the society. Therefore, it is particularly important to implement quality control of the diagnosis and treatment process. In this paper, we propose a lung cancer quality control model based on the standardized judgment of the treatment model to address the requirements of lung cancer treatment quality control, the complex content of medical text data, and the irregular recording time. First, the word vector is trained by BERT pre-training model; then, the K-medoids algorithm is used to mine the standardized treatment patterns, and the time-aware LSTM unit is used to deal with the uneven input interval on this basis; finally, the attention mechanism is introduced to highlight the different contributions of the visit days to complete the prediction of the next cycle of lung cancer treatment items. The experimental results showed that the recall and average accuracy of the BERT-TLSTM-ATT fusion model reached 0.895 and 0.782, respectively, which performed well compared with other models and effectively controlled the quality of next-cycle treatment, achieving the goal of quality control of all aspects of lung cancer treatment.

articleTitle: Face Mask Recognition and Normative Detection Algorithm Based on Attention Mechanism Fusion and Image Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Under the current normalized management of the epidemic situation, due to the dense population in public places and small detection targets, it is difficult for manual supervision to play a certain role. At the same time, the existing recognition algorithms still have certain deficiencies in whether masks are worn or not. Face mask recognition based on YOLOv5s and fusion of multi-scale attention features and wearing standard detection algorithm using HSV and YCrCb image filtering. The experimental results show that after the introduction of the CBAM attention module, the mAP reaches 73.76%, which is an increase of 1.69%. The skin color of the mouth and nose area of the face is extracted, and the accuracy of mask wearing standard detection reaches 84.93%, which meets the needs of practical applications.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition Based on Boundary Enhanced for Chinese Electronic Medical Records
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the continuous popularization of medical informatization, the number of medical documents, medical guides, electronic medical records and other medical texts shows a trend of rapid growth and huge scale. Medical texts contain great social value. However, most medical texts exist in an unstructured form and cannot be directly applied to products. Therefore, how to fully explore the potential valuable information has become a hot research direction in the field of natural language processing. Named entity recognition is the basic task of natural language processing, and also the key task of medical data mining and analysis. It also lays the foundation for downstream tasks such as medical term relationship extraction and medical term standardization. Named entity recognition aims to find some key phrases in a large number of texts, such as people's names, place names, diseases and drugs. At present, named entity recognition has made great achievements in the open field, but there are still many problems in the research of named entity recognition in the medical field, such as the strong professionalism of entities, the long length of some types of entities, and the existence of complex entities mixed in Chinese and English. Aiming at the problem that the length of named entities in existing medical electronic medical records is longer than that in other fields, resulting in low extraction accuracy, a named entity recognition algorithm based on boundary enhancement is proposed. The model adopts the method of multi-task learning, which can effectively alleviate the boundary problem caused by the length of medical terms. We have tried various models on our medical electronic medical record data set. Experimental results show that this method is simple and effective in medical named entity recognition.

articleTitle: Design of Energy-Saving Ventilation Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the phenomenon of excessive power consumption in the Ventilation monitoring, an energy-saving Ventilation monitoring system is designed. Based on STM32, the system monitors and obtains ambient temperature and humidity atmosphere through temperature and humidity sensors, and monitors ambient air quality through gas sensors, and wireless communication modules to send and receive data to the terminal. According to the reasonable working conditions of the Ventilation, the circuit design is carried out, and the intelligent control of the Ventilation is completed through the identification and judgment of the environmental temperature, humidity and gas quality of the Ventilation. When the intelligent monitoring system works, according to the change of environmental conditions, the switching power management module can realize the power supply of the sensor and the wireless communication module under different working modes, and only supply power when needed. The engery-saving system is easy to control, simple to operate and can reduce energy loss.

articleTitle: Research on Connectivity and Coverage of WSNs Based on Complex Network Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In harsh environments, wireless sensor networks need to be deployed randomly and unattended. Based on this premise, the network structure is analyzed, and the complex wireless sensor network under random scattering is divided into a giant connected component, a small number of isolated nodes and a small number of isolated areas. The complex network characteristics of the giant connected components are studied, and a connectivity analysis method of wireless sensor networks based on degree, average degree and node density is proposed. After simulation and analysis, the conclusions are as follows: firstly, there is a critical region in the node communication radius. In this region, with the increase of the communication radius, the network connectivity rate will rise rapidly until it is basically fully connected. Secondly, under a certain node density, the critical region can be determined by the communication radius, and then the coverage can be determined. Finally, after predetermined network connectivity and coverage, the more appropriate communication radius and average degree can be estimated.

articleTitle: Fusion of Visible and Infrared Images Using Efficient Online Convolutional Dictionary Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: To balance fusion performance and time consumption, this paper proposes a fast and effective infrared and visible fusion method using online convolutional dictionary learning (OCDL). First, source images are decomposed into low-pass layers and a detail layers using low-pass filtering technique. Then low-pass fused layer is obtained using ‘average’ rule. The dictionary trained on Flicker-large dataset using OCDL is applied to detail layer fusion, which uses ADMM-based CSC and ‘maximum’ strategy to calculate fused high-pass components. Finally, fused image is reconstructed based on fused low-pass components and high-pass components. The subjective results and objective metrics of the infrared-visible image fusion experiments show that our designed fusion method ensures quality of fused images and outperforms advanced online convolutional sparse coding (OCSC) based fusion methods in terms of computational cost and memory requirements. Our method averagely increases objective metrics (Cross entropy, NMI, PSNR, NABF and CC) by 13.66%, 6.42%, 0.03%, 74.77% and 0.21% compared to OCSC. Meanwhile, our method improved 10.1% beyond OCSC in terms of time consumption.

articleTitle: Fatigue Monitoring and Awakening System Based on Eye Electrical and Head Movement Parameters Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: When the human body is in a state of fatigue, its characteristics of eye electrical signals and head posture signals will change significantly. Based on the analysis and research of these two kinds of signals, a wearable EOG and head posture signal fatigue monitoring and wake-up system is proposed by combining music wake-up method. The single lead electrode is used to collect the EOG signal, and the three-axis gyroscope sensor is used to collect the acceleration and angular velocity signals when the human head moves. The characteristics of the blinking signal are analyzed through the EOG signal, and four head posture characteristics are analyzed according to the characteristics of the acceleration and angular velocity in the time domain. Finally, the BP neural network is used to identify the features of the relevant signals. When the fatigue features reach a certain level, physical stimulation, such as music, can help people wake up. The experimental results show that the EOG signal and acceleration signal can accurately analyze the fatigue characteristics and changes of testers, and the wake-up method is effective.

articleTitle: Medical Assistant Visual Teaching System Based on VTK
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In the field of modern medical teaching, the use of Computed Tomography (CT), Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and other equipment to obtain is a two-dimensional image sequence [1], which is not intuitive enough and makes the images difficult to understand. In order to solve the deficiencies in the video teaching method of slides and textbooks, to improve the quality of teaching and the practical ability of students, this paper implements a 3D visualization system based on VTK (visualization toolkit) for medical assistant teaching. This system uses the VTK toolkit. The three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm reconstructs the two-dimensional tomographic sequence of the organ into a three-dimensional organ, visualizes the reconstructed three-dimensional model in the Unity3D engine. The teaching module synchronizes the scene resources to other clients for teaching. Realize the playback of teaching content based on frame synchronization. The collaborative simulation surgery module uses VR (Virtual Reality) equipment to conduct collaborative simulation training, record the training situation in real time and summarize it after the end, so as to facilitate the identification of deficiencies in the task.

articleTitle: An Ameliorated Algorithm of Hybrid Vulture Optimization Based on Lens Reverse Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Cloud platform usually allows multiple tasks to perform in parallel, and as an important cornerstone of cloud platforms, the quality of task scheduling strategies is related to the replication quality and system performance of the entire cloud analysis platform. Its scheduling efficiency directly affects the operating factor of cloud computing virtual machines and other software and hardware resources and the quality of service for users. To improve the productiveness of the process of assigning tasks to virtual computing resources in cloud platforms, there advanced a mixed meta heuristic algorithm algorithm, called LBE algorithm (LiL-Baldeagle-ESDA Optimization Algothrim), which combines the reflection imaging principle of lens, finds another position point in the solution space, broaden the solution domain, and prevent the solution from plung in the global suboptimal or part optimal solution. Combining the advantages of the Electrostatic Discharge Algorithm (ESDA) to address the shortcomings of the Bald Eagle Search Optimization Algorithm (BES) in global solution domain. This article uses 23 classic checkout functions from early CEC to trail the behavior of algorithm, and contrast to the results of several scriptures' algorithms. The test value on the function set indicate that the proposed LBE has advantages within the solution space, convergence rate and optimization ability.

articleTitle: RDF Date Storage Scheme Based on Graph Database
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The structure can be directly mapped to the RDF model, and RDF data can be stored in the graph database. There is no need to rebuild the RDF graph to query the semantic information data of RDF. Based on the RDF data storage Scheme of graph database, the research status of RDF data storage and the transformation of SPARQL query language into Cypher graph query language are discussed emphatically. It is verified by experiments that the Neo4j graph database can further improve the query efficiency while satisfying the query of RDF graph data.

articleTitle: Speed Control of PMSM Based on Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Nonlinear, multivariable, strong coupling, etc. are the characteristics of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). In view of the low efficiency of the traditional proportional integral derivative (PID) controller and its poor adaptability to the changes of the working environment, an intelligent control method based on the improved whale optimization of PID controller parameters is proposed. In view of some shortcomings of traditional algorithms, chaos theory is introduced to generate initial population to increase population diversity and lay the foundation for global search of algorithm. In addition, the linear convergence factor is changed to nonlinear, and the adaptive inertia weight is added to improve the convergence speed and accuracy. Finally, the vector control model of PMSM is built in Matlab/simulink for simulation experiment. Through simulation and comparison, the effectiveness of the improved whale optimization algorithm (IWOA) for tuning PID parameters is verified.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Filtering Algorithm with Improved User Similarity Calculation for Enhanced Recommendation Accuracy and Personalization
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The conventional method for calculating user similarity in the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on users fails to address the challenge of variations in the number, value, and popularity of items that are collaboratively rated by multiple users. In order to solve the above problems, a new user similarity calculation method is proposed. By fusing cosine similarity and Jackard similarity, the problem of difference in the number of common scoring items is alleviated, so as to reduce the error of scoring prediction. Finally, experiments were performed on the MovieLens dataset, and the findings demonstrated that the enhanced algorithm outperforms the established benchmark similarity algorithm regarding mean absolute error (MAE). In addition, the improved algorithm has good robustness in predicting the accuracy of user ratings and recommendation quality.

articleTitle: Credit Text Similarity Calculation Method Combined with Contrast Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The text matching task aims at mining the inherent semantic features from two texts and predicting the correlation or contradiction between texts. The credit text phases have obvious domain-specific features, and there are more adversarial texts, and most of them are of different lengths leading to missing information and unclear main ideas, which will reduce the accuracy of similarity calculation. To this end, this paper proposes a credit text similarity calculation method combined with contrast learning. First, we will recall the candidate set by multi-level text recall method to reduce the influence of non-critical factors and reduce the computational effort of text matching model from shallow semantics, deep semantics and entities. And then fine-tunes the pre-trained model by combining with contrast learning method to calculate the semantic text similarity. The comparison experimental results with BERT and SimCSE show that the text similarity calculation method proposed in this paper works better.

articleTitle: Trusted Charity System Based on Blockchain Access Control
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: At present, there are widespread problems in traditional centralized charity systems such as unclear information about the flow of funds, centralized data easily tampered with, and data security not guaranteed, so public charity systems need a trusted and decentralized solution. Blockchain has the property of self-trust because of its tamper-proof and traceable nature. It enables mutual trust among stakeholders without the need for third-party proof. The adoption of blockchain technology can solve the trust problem in charity systems and improve the transparency and trust of charitable organizations. To this end, this paper proposes a trusted charity system based on blockchain access control by combining the traceable and tamper-evident characteristics of blockchain with the charity field.

articleTitle: Prediction of Coagulant Dosage in Waterworks Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: There are many processes of water treatment in waterworks, among which coagulation and precipitation plays an important role, which is directly related to the guarantee of water quality. The traditional coagulant dosing technology relies too much on manual labor, has poor stability and high drug consumption. The rapid development of artificial intelligence and machine learning provides a new way to solve the coagulant prediction problem. Combined with the advanced theory of artificial intelligence, a prediction method of coagulant based on multi-model fusion Stacking ensemble learning approach is proposed in this paper. Considering the differences in data observation and training principles of different algorithms, the advantages of each model are fully utilized to build a Stacking ensemble learning model for coagulant prediction with multiple machine learning algorithms embedded, and the base learners of the model contain XGBoost and SVR. Data processing goes through steps such as missing value filling, outlier detection, data conversion, and combining with business scenarios for feature construction, feature selection, etc. Finally, the validity of the algorithm was verified using the production data of a water plant. The prediction results show that the coagulant prediction method based on Stacking ensemble learning approach with multi-model fusion has higher prediction accuracy compared with the traditional single-model prediction.

articleTitle: Between Detection and Segmentation: A Row Selection Based Detector for Crop Line Detection in Paddy Field
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Visual-based navigation in fields is mainly achieved by following crop lines, so crop line detection is a fundamental task of agricultural automation. The main challenge for crop line detection in paddy fields is to overcome challenges from a semi-constrained environment. It means that the surroundings of the paddy field are variable and exist many distractions. In a typical paddy field, UGVs may encounter brightness variation, surface reflection, and irregular crop seedling placement which can cause row detection inaccuracy. We hope to use the powerful deep learning technique to overcome environmental distractions that can affect the accuracy of crop line detection. Inspired by similar lane detection task for auto driving in semiconstrained environments. This article proposed a crop line detection model based on the row selection method and auxiliary learning technique. Unlike previous works regarding crop line detection as a semantic segmentation task or object detection task, using the row selection method can directly distinguish each line in the field and result in a lower computational cost. As there is no publicly available large-scale dataset for crop line detection in the paddy field, this work also makes a small dataset containing crop line in various growing conditions and propose an offline data argumentation called LineMix. Experiments were conducted using the dataset we create and the results confirmed that the proposed model achieves better accuracy and less computational cost compared with the semantic segmentation method and object detection method which achieve 92.6 in the accuracy metric and 84.4 fps when inference.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology and Application of Epidemiological Survey Using Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Epidemiological survey of infected people, infected suspects, and their close contacts (hereinafter referred to as epidemiological survey) is the core and key link in the health and quarantine work at ports. However, the work of ports epidemiological surveys mainly depends on the way of manual or simple remote connection. The quality of epidemiological surveys is greatly affected by the staff's technical level and working status. There are deficiencies and hidden dangers in fixing the risk of infection, the type of epidemic disease, the diagnosis of follow-up treatment measures, and the infection of the staff in the flow survey. In this paper, we designed an epidemiological survey system using modern high-tech information technology such as knowledge graph, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data mining, speech recognition, and natural language processing and applies it to the ports entry epidemiological surveys. It effectively lessened human participation, quickly completed the survey, and screening of suspicious cases, which provides technical support and guarantee for improving the overall defense and control capability and level of national security and building smart ports.

articleTitle: A New Multimodal Video Detection Model and Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In this work, we discuss the issue of multimodal detection of long and short video violations on Internet environment. We collect and annotate a dataset consisting of 6000 videos from different platforms, and offer a joint model of video frame sequences and text sequences to analyze video and text information for violation detection. We also do a comparison with the unimodal model. As far as we know, this is the first multimodal dataset proposed for the detection of violations involving “pornography and violence”. And the model adapts to the conversion of video unimodal data to multimodal data. Experiments found that although text unimodal recognition results are limited, the complementarity of the modalities in the multimodal case gives a large improvement in the results. We discuss the reasons for the results and open the codes and dataset in this domain for further study. The address is https://github.com/weijingxuan/multivideo.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Trend Prediction Using CLS-Net Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The break out of Corona Virus Disease 2019 has caused great danger and effect for people's health and life. Therefore, predicting the trend of the epidemic is crucial for politicians and medical conductors go for make correct policy ahead of time. The SEIR model is now a more mature epidemic prediction model, but the dynamic prediction of the outbreak cannot be achieved because in this model, the infection rate of virus can be calculated mathematically. Based on this problem, this thesis proposes a CLS-Net model to predict the trend of global epidemic of Corona Virus Disease 2019 under the influence of human mobility. The model extracts features from a large amount of population migration data by CNN model, and then predicts the transmission rate of New Coronavirus in real time with the excellent time-series learning ability of LSTM. Finally, the live updated virus infection rate apply into the SEIR model to realize the dynamic prediction of epidemic development trend. To validate the approach proposed in paper, the statistical data of neocrown pneumonia from various countries around the world were collected for experiments. Take Mean Absolute Error (MAE), R2(R-Squared) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) as the evaluation indexes of the model in this paper. The experimental results show that the model proposed in this paper has better performance compared with the classical infectious disease prediction model.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Construction Method for Mobile IOT Management Platform Device Anomaly
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Mobile IOT management platform equipment abnormal information contains a large amount of data knowledge, and it provides decision support for intelligent operation and maintenance of power communication equipment. However, such data are mostly stored as unstructured data and cannot be directly extracted for inferential decision making. In this paper, with the advantage of knowledge graph in data storage and knowledge extraction, we propose Multi-feature entity relationship joint extraction methods (MFERJE), which firstly generates word vectors by using ALBERT word embedding model, and then realizes word vectors by using BiLSTM structure and attention mechanism to achieve multi-feature entity recognition, and finally discriminate multi-type entity relationship based on graphical matrix to obtain the entities and relationships contained in abnormal data, using location, entity label and lexicality as feature inputs to greatly reduce the loss of semantic information features, achieve effective utilization of equipment abnormal data, and achieve equipment abnormal information based on the knowledge of equipment abnormal fault alarm visualization of equipment abnormal information based on equipment abnormal fault warning knowledge. The experimental results show that the F1 value of the model reaches 0.78, the accuracy is improved by 4% compared with other traditional methods, and the knowledge extraction effect is better, which can effectively improve the efficiency of equipment maintenance, realize the accurate positioning of equipment abnormalities and the rapid retrieval of corresponding maintenance strategies, and promote the intelligent operation and maintenance of mobile IOT management platform.

articleTitle: Power Distribution Network Fault Recovery Based on Improved DQN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: When a branch fault occurs in the power distribution network, what kind of algorithm can be used to safely, quickly and accurately eliminate the fault and restore the power distribution network to the previous state is an urgent problem to be solved. Due to the diversity and complexity of the power distribution network topology, as well as the sparseness and inaccessibility of fault data, the processing of power distribution network fault recovery will be greatly affected. In order to solve various problems in power distribution network fault recovery, by combining the characteristics of reinforcement learning, such as autonomous learning and running without training samples, and the good data fit of neural network, a power distribution network fault based on DQN (Deep Q-Network) is proposed. The algorithm has been restored and some improvements have been made to the experience replay and reward mechanism in the algorithm, and a significant improvement has been achieved. Through the simulation experiments of fault recovery of power distribution networks with different structures, the results show that the algorithm can effectively realize the recovery processing function of the faulty branch.

articleTitle: Internet Financial Data Mining and Analysis Based on Internet Data
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Based on the financial data in the Internet, the system uses data mining technology to collect and mine the specified target financial data from the financial website page, provide corresponding financial information according to the needs of different groups, and create a financial business operation law and financial business information for today's college students and financial practitioners. The statistical analysis system of financial risk dynamics and other information completes the real-time collection of financial data with time series in Internet financial websites, so that those in need can know the real-time information and data analysis of the financial industry at any time. The system also provides personalized customized services for practitioners, complete financial screening plans, and realize the dynamic visualization of financial information. A service platform for online communication and information sharing between employees and social people. In most cases, financial data is expressed in the form of time series. This project proposes the relevant financial data mining and analysis system platform, which can efficiently mine the potential high-value data in the massive financial time series data, and is also conducive to the research of financial data analysis system in data mining. The research of this project has a certain degree of theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Using Fuzzy Clustering with SVM in Credit Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: It suffers from the lack of user classification information in the credit data of the People's Bank of China, and there are a lot of descriptive variables for each user, which restricts the availability of credit reports in financial institutions. In order to address this issue, this paper marks the credit report by constructing fuzzy numbers and using fuzzy clustering, and classifies the credit users with support vector machines on the basis of the marks. From the experiments, it can be seen that fuzzy clustering gives an significant improvement in classifying users' credit information.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm of Multi-Type and Multi-Objective Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of modern logistics distribution, this paper proposes a multi-type vehicle and multi-objective vehicle routing optimization method with time windows. In the process of dispatching vehicles to participate in transportation, enterprises will have various factors that will not fully meet customer needs. On this basis, three objective functions are proposed, namely, the total cost is as low as possible, the number of customers served is as large as possible, and the distribution volume is as large as possible. The corresponding mathematical model is established. The problem is solved through the MOEA/DP algorithm. In order to improve the quality of the solution and avoid falling into local optimization, the self-crossover operator and modified mutation operation are introduced in the algorithm. The experimental results show that the algorithm is feasible in solving the problem of multi vehicle routing with time windows.

articleTitle: Construction of Meteorological Emergency Communication System Based on Portable Satellite Emergency Communication Station
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In recent years, the state has increased investment in meteorological undertakings, meteorological modernization has penetrated into all aspects of the meteorological field, and meteorological detection means and capabilities have been greatly improved. Emergency mobile communication system is based on the actual use needs of users, using short wave, ultra-short wave, trunking, satellite, microwave and other wireless communication means and wired networks, etc., to comprehensively integrate and upgrade the vehicle-borne platform, and build an emergency mobile communication system. Communication security in emergency command system should also be the key issue that people should pay attention to. Because satellite communication is basically used in emergency communication, this paper makes a deep discussion on the data encryption in satellite communication, and puts forward a mixed encryption scheme with elliptic curve to solve the encryption of satellite communication data in emergency command. In practice, the location of satellite communication portable stations is reasonably applied to the emergency communication management, and a case study of the location of satellite communication portable stations in large-scale emergencies is carried out to verify the effectiveness and scientificity of the model. At the same time, it provides a useful reference for the potential application of the emergency location model of satellite communication portable stations given in this paper.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Electric Supply Reliability Evaluation Model for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The scale of distribution network is expanding, the construction of distribution automation and ubiquitous power Internet of Things is advancing, and the multi-level and multisource real-time operation monitoring data of distribution network is growing exponentially. On the one hand, big data provides data support for distribution network reliability evaluation and dispatching planning, in different aspects, this also raises other requirements for the calculation accuracy and speed of reliability evaluation. How to mine the factors that have a great impact on reliability and make better use of electric data analysis algorithm to predict the changes of distribution network reliability in the future time scale is the focus of research. This article mainly taking technical breakthrough in electric distribution network data analysis, and studies its reliability evaluation methods of electric data analysis from both recent and forward aspects. First of all, the source of distribution network big data is analyzed from the internal and external aspects of the power system, and the data, data formats and relationships among the data source systems are analyzed. The characteristics of distribution network big data, such as wide source, diverse structure, fine granularity and complex relationships, are obtained in many ways. In view of the characteristics of multi-source and heterogeneous distribution network data, this paper puts forward a data processing algorithm based on multi-source data and a truth value discovery algorithm based on block coordinate descent method, which find out a new approach to overcome the difficulty of inconsistency and conflict of multi-source monitoring data.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial Non-Destructive Testing Technology Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Non-destructive testing technology plays a pivotal role in the manufacturing process of modern industrial products, and is of incredible importance for moving forward the item quality of workpieces. Currently, the commonly used non-destructive testing technology has disadvantages such as complicated operation, high testing cost, and limited scope of application. This paper suggests an upgraded multi-scale target detection algorithm based on YOLOv5s in light of the aforementioned issues. Firstly, an improved channel attention mechanism module ECA-Net is added into the backbone network. Second, the maximum pooling operation in the SPP module is replaced with atrous convolution in this paper. Finally, the channel weight information is added to the concat operation of the PAN structure, which improves the sensitivity of the network to the channel information of the feature map. This paper uses the NEU-DET steel surface defect data set to do a series of experiments to verify the detection effect of the model. According to the experimental results, the mAP of the algorithm proposed in this paper is 73.47%, which is 7.18% higher than that of YOLOv5s, and the FPS is 68.5 frames/s, which satisfies the needs of industrial production environments.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Electric Power Line Loss Analysis Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Electric power supply line loss is a very important economic indicator of the State Grid Corporation of China, which is a comprehensive reflection of many important indicators. For companies of electric supply, the loss of supply of electric power lines is not only related to the operating income and economic benefits of enterprises of electric power supply, but also related to the cost and welfare of people's livelihood. Up to now, the State Grid Corporation of China (SGCC) is responding to the policy of energy conservation and emission reduction proposed in the 13th Five Year Plan, and has begun to carry out refined management of power supply line loss, so as to promote the reduction of power consumption, save energy consumption, and achieve stable and sustainable economic and social development and operation. In the past, the management of power supply line loss mainly relied on manual calculation of the loss. This method is inefficient, error prone and has great side effects. At the same time, the complexity of line loss calculation for different voltage levels of distribution network is different, which will inevitably lead to error of line loss data due to negligence and affect the accuracy. In view of the above situation, this article aims to find out all the causes of power supply line loss, and then sort out the correlation between these factors to accurately locate the line loss, in order to improve the refined ability of management on power enterprises and enhance enterprise benefits.

articleTitle: Real-Time Classification and Detection of Garbage Based on Improved Yolov5 and Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Garbage classification is an important environmental issue, and accurate sorting of different types of waste is critical for effective recycling and waste management. Deep learning technology has great potential for garbage classification, and with the growing importance of waste management, it is highly likely that the role of image recognition in this field will continue to increase in the future. However, most of the existing garbage classification and detection methods only consider the detection accuracy of garbage, which are not real-time and can hardly meet the practical application of garbage classification. To address this problem, a new real-time classification and detection of garbage based on improved yolov5 and adapted to an embedded system from UAV images is proposed, which is named as G-YOLOv5s. First, residual dilated convolution module(Res-DConv) is employed to extract the spatial features, which can increase the receptive field. Then, a feature fusion module(BDSCAM) is designed to enhance the expressive ability of object feature, which could improve the classification performance of detector. The localization task is performed using a Double-Head method, which is an integration system of fully connected and convolutional heads for bounding box regression and classification. The proposed G-YOLOv5s method was evaluated using Huawei Garbage Classification Challenge Cup dataset. We found that the experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is high accuracy and efficient for garbage classification and detection on the embedded system. This approach is robust and suitable for practical application in garbage classification scenarios.

articleTitle: H-CE: An Event Correlation Discriminant Model Based on Event Composition Features and Embedded Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Finding a relationship between events and mining particular event types between events are the two objectives of the event correlation identification work. The approach put out in this research is capable of processing and analyzing the structured text representation content of events, such as control and monitoring on the Internet of Things, and it can also carry out Event Correlation Analysis in Collaborative Processes in Industrialization Scenarios. Previous studies mostly dealt with unstructured text data and employed techniques like event extraction, relation extraction, and deep learning models for correlation analysis. Since the data in this study is structured and categorized by different event kinds, it is challenging to utilize a deep learning model to directly analyze the relationships between events. Therefore, this paper first constructs a data set of character behavior characteristics (GKD-BehaviorData) and proposes a general event representation method. Then, based on the previous research on case reasoning and machine learning, a hybrid computing method (Hybrid-Composition&Embedding Method, H-CE) based on event composition features and knowledge embedding is proposed. The results of the studies show that this method is noticeably superior to the event correlation calculation method based on event correlation characteristics, with improvements in the acc and F1 values of 17.4% and 19.7%, respectively.

articleTitle: Wordle simulation system based on human brain thinking
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: The study of the human brain's thinking has been of great interest to researchers, in order to observe the way the human brain decodes words. In this paper, Wordle, an educational word-guessing game, is selected. Its commercial nature determines that the heat and reported results have high commercial value. In playing, the difficulty of each word is estimated, and the common method is to extract the static features of words and perform multiple regression, but this method lacks accuracy and interpretability. Therefore, this paper proposes a Wordle simulation system based on human brain thinking. Due to the self-motivating characteristics of the reported results, we build a Hawkes self-motivating-ARIMA model. The dynamic wordle database is constructed by imitating the logic of human problem solving. The dynamic priority is determined with TOPSIS using the extracted metrics. A distribution of results for the general case can be achieved. The validation is then performed using EERIE, and after validation, for the modified simulation model <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R2 = 0.75$</tex>, the percentage distribution of EERIE is (0, 2, 10, 18, 36, 29, 5). Finally, the analysis for sensitivity is performed and the model is proved to be resistant to interference. This system can quickly and efficiently analyze the difficulty of the words as well as the method, which is advanced.

articleTitle: Research on High-Frequency Current Sensor and Measurement Method Based on Magnetic Sensor Array
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of smart grid makes the grid structure more complicated. In order to ensure the stable, efficient and safe operation of the power grid, the smart grid puts forward higher requirements for the accuracy and real-time collection of information (including node current and voltage). Magnetic sensor array is usually placed in the surrounding space of multi-conductor system in a non-contact way to measure current. In order to study the theoretical errors caused by the topology of magnetic sensor array, based on the current measurement algorithm of discrete Fourier transform (DFT), the topology optimization model of magnetic sensor array is established with the objective function of solving the minimum condition number of coefficient matrix, and some optimization constraints are put forward. After studying the principle of optical current sensor, a current measurement method combining giant magnetostrictive material and fiber grating is adopted in this paper to achieve the purpose of measuring current. Using Visual C++software as the development platform, an experimental simulation platform for AC voltage/current intelligent sensor signal processing was created. Through a large number of simulation experiments, the signal processing methods based on the least mean error method, correlation analysis method, and the estimation of key sampling points based on Lagrange interpolation method and error LMS method were verified.

articleTitle: Research and Expectation of a New Generation of Smart Energy Meter based on IR46 Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the acceleration of the construction of “Smart Grid” and “Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)” worldwide, smart energy meter, as a key sensor and measurement point distributed on the network, should have functions such as communication, load control, online upgrade, parameter protection, legal measurement and non-metering partial isolation in addition to basic energy measurement. To this end, China newly revised JJF 1245-2019 standard fully adopts the “Active Energy Meter” (IR46) formulated by the International Legal Metrology Organization, and stipulates the software and hardware requirements and type certification of the new generation of smart energy meters. This paper first discusses the requirements of a new generation of smart energy meters, compares the differences between IR46 and Chinese energy meter standard systems, introduces some key technologies of smart energy meters that support IR46 standards, and finally expounds the next research direction and application prospects of IR46 smart energy meters.

articleTitle: Industrial Pollutant Forecast Based on Time Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Environmental problems are potential problems under the current rapid economic development. The establishment of an industrial pollutant prediction model is conducive to the supervision and prevention of pollution emissions in industrial parks, accelerating industrial transformation and building an industrial modernization system. In this paper, by introducing the characteristics of power data, a hybrid residual correction model based on the combination of time convolution network and BP neural network is established. First, the time series characteristics of power data and pollution emission data are integrated through time convolution network model to obtain preliminary prediction results. The residual sequence of prediction results is predicted through the BP model of particle swarm optimization algorithm, and the original results are modified and enhanced. In order to verify the performance of the model, the power data and pollutant related data of an industrial park in Hunnan District, Shenyang City were used for experiments. Compared with the conventional prediction model, the experimental results show that the prediction results of this model have better prediction accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Debonding Degree of Building Exterior Wall Bricks Based on ISSA-KELM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: In recent years, the building exterior wall tiles falling off caused a lot of damage to property and injuries, in order to achieve more accurate off, put forward using percussion method to extract the sound signal characteristics combined with pattern recognition method for building exterior wall tiles debonding degree were studied. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of the debonding degree of building exterior brick, a prediction method of the debonding degree of building exterior brick based on the improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA) and optimized kernel extreme learning machine (KELM) was proposed. In order to overcome the disadvantages of the standard sparrow search algorithm(SSA), such as uneven population distribution and easy to fall into local optimum, the algorithm firstly uses Circle chaotic map to generate the initial population with uniform distribution, and then uses the elite opposition-based(EOBL) learning strategy to broaden the search domain of the algorithm, obtain elite sparrows, avoid algorithms falling into local optimality. The KELM parameters were optimized by ISSA algorithm, and a prediction model based on the degree of brick debonding outside KELM was established. The characteristic data of sound signal collected from building exterior brick of different degree of debonding were used to study. The results indicate that the proposed method is superior KELM, PSO-KELM, GWO-KELM and SSA-KELM algorithms, and has certain applicability to detect the degree of debonding of building exterior brick.

articleTitle: Rolling Bearing Fault Feature Extraction Based on EMD-CEP-SR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Rolling bearing is one of the most important parts of rotating machinery, For the problem that the fault characteristics of rolling bearing vibration signals is difficult to identify due to strong noise and discrete frequency component interference, a method based on Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD)-Cepstrum Editing Procedure (CEP)-Stochastic Resonance (SR) gearbox rolling bearing fault diagnosis methods. First, the sampled signal is pre-processed by EMD noise reduction based on the correlation number and cliff criterion to highlight the high frequency resonance components; then, the pre-whitening algorithm is used to process the noise-reduced vibration signal to enhance the impact characteristics and generate a signal containing white noise and bearing fault information; finally, the normalized stochastic resonance is combined with the bearing envelope signal as the input of the detection model to enhance the frequency components of bearing fault features. Realize the feature origin of the fault. The feasibility of the algorithm in the fault diagnosis of rolling bearings in gearboxes was verified by simulating and analyzing the rolling bearing data from Case Western Reserve University. Moreover, the local spectral cliffness and local signal-to-noise ratio at the bearing fault feature frequency were used as indicators to compare with the EMD-SK method and the CEP-SR method. The results show that, compared with the two algorithms, EMD-CEP-SR has stronger anti-noise and more superiority.

articleTitle: Maritime Emergency Search and Rescue Early Warning System Based on Sonar Positioning
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the development of China's shipbuilding industry, China has developed into a large maritime country. The density of ships at sea has increased, and the probability of dangerous accidents has gradually increased. At present, China's current maritime search and rescue capabilities are insufficient. This paper focuses on China's existing maritime For the problem of insufficient search and rescue capabilities, starting from the traditional sonar positioning principle, a maritime emergency search and rescue early warning system based on sonar positioning is proposed and designed, combined with existing signal processing technology, data acquisition and data classification learning algorithms, greatly improved Maritime positioning accuracy, and the system will be carried out on-the-spot experiments. The experiment passes the two measurement ranges of 0–50 m and 50–100 m and the voltage data measured by the hydrophone, and the accuracy rate of the distance measurement of the target object is obtained through processing and calculation It can reach 85%, which meets the setting requirements of use.

articleTitle: Multi-Body Collaborative Scheduling Strategy Based on Bessel Curve and Grey Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, the development of intelligent technology is getting faster and faster, and the application of intelligent applications is getting wider and wider. Intelligent trolley as one of the intelligent applications has developed rapidly and is widely used in production life. Smart trolleys and the products generated on the basis of smart trolley research have become the key equipment for automated logistics transportation. Intelligent trolley reasonable path planning can choose the best path [1]–[2], and then improve production efficiency. To pursue high efficiency in the work of smart carts, choosing the path with the shortest movement time is one of the methods to improve efficiency. In this paper, by analyzing the kinematic mechanism of the two-dimensional motion of the trolley and establishing a two-dimensional planar path planning model and a nonlinear planning model by combining the principles of multi-body collaborative scheduling [3], we study the influence of the position and attitude of the initial and termination points of the trolley and the midway path planning scheme on the formation change time, and seek the shortest time of scheduling under the premise of avoiding collision. In this paper, two main aspects are considered. First, considering the non-collision constraint, square area constraint, velocity constraint and acceleration constraint, the optimization model is established with the objective of minimizing the maximum time used by each cart to reach the target point. Second, combined with the minimum radius of curvature restriction when the intelligent cart does arc motion, the motion process of the cart is divided into arc-linear-arc three segments to establish the cart path planning model under the requirement of seeking the shortest path and the final arrival of the cart at the target azimuth. Considering the non-collision constraint, square area constraint, velocity constraint and acceleration constraint, the Bessel curve [4] is used to plan the path to avoid the obstacles in the area where collision may occur, and the optimization model is established with the goal of shortest dispatch time.

articleTitle: A Density Routing Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks for Dangerous Chemicals Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks have been widely used in large petrochemical production parks, especially in the safety monitoring of dangerous chemicals. Due to the on-site environment factors, the performance of the wireless sensor monitoring networks is usually attenuated. First, the performance evaluation parameters for WSNs density routing were identified, and the relationships between node energy, hop count and routing were described. Meanwhile, aimed at solving the routing problem of wireless sensor networks (WSNs), a density routing algorithm is established based on dynamic reservation and optimized based on anti-collision principles. Finally, key factors in the DRADR algorithm are intensively investigated by simulations. The experimental results indicate DRADR algorithm have great advantages over conventional algorithms in data transmission rate, node life cycle, residual energy and other metrics. Therefore, the DRADR scheme can be applied in large petrochemical park to improve the quality of dangerous chemicals monitoring. The issue of the existing routing methods in dangerous chemical monitoring is that data transmission rate is low. The DRADR algorithm shows advantages in data transmission rate over the DBR algorithm and the Epidemic algorithm. The energy consumption in the DRADR algorithm can be reduced below that in the DBR algorithm by adjusting the node distribution. The DRADR algorithm shows great advantages in extension of network life and reduction of energy consumption. The DRADR algorithm and the DBR algorithm can effectively reduce resource waste while maintaining constant increasing rate of transmission rates. However, transmissions in the DBR algorithm rely on relay nodes. The DRADR algorithm is superior to the DBR algorithm in data transmission rate. The opportunistic network routing algorithm (Epidemic) is that the number of nodes increases more; the flooding strategy of Epidemic will cause serious network congestion, resulting in a decrease in the transmission success rate. Compared to the DBR algorithm, the DRADR algorithm is characterized by data forwarding strategy with dynamic selection and data transcriptions can be transmitted to nodes with higher activity to enhance the data transmission rate. The energy consumption in the DRADR algorithm can be reduced below that in the DBR algorithm by adjusting the node distribution. The network residual energy in the DRADR algorithm is higher than that in the DBR algorithm, as well as the network life cycle.

articleTitle: Regional Air Quality Prediction Model Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Air quality prediction is of great significance for the daily travel of the public, the government to control air pollution and promote green development. In view of the problem that most current researches in the field is the daily prediction of air quality index, there are few studies on the prediction of a variety of specific pollutant concentrations. In this paper, a Deep Belief Network-Extreme Learning Machine (DBN-ELM) air quality prediction model combined with attention mechanism is proposed. Firstly, DBN is used to extract the features of air quality data, and the robustness of network is enhanced by using the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize initial weights. To address the spatial correlation of air quality in the region, the attention mechanism is used to fuse the features of data from different monitoring sites, and the fused feature data are input into ELM for prediction, then the hourly concentrations of six air pollutants are obtained. The experimental results show that the prediction results of the proposed model are better than other comparison models, and it has good prediction performance, which provides a new idea for the field of air quality prediction.

articleTitle: Preface ICTech 2023
publicationTitle: 2023 12th International Conference of Information and Communication Technology (ICTech)
abstract: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) has revolutionized the way modern organizations operate and has become an integral part of their functioning. ICT encompasses a broad range of technologies and tools that enable organizations to store, retrieve, manipulate, and transmit data and information. With the advent of new technologies and tools, organizations can now process vast amounts of data in real-time, collaborate with stakeholders across the world, and make more informed decisions. Moreover, ICT has transformed modern organizations is through the digitization of business processes. With the help of ICT, organizations can now automate many of their repetitive and time-consuming tasks, such as data entry, invoicing, and inventory management. This has freed up employees to focus on more strategic tasks, such as analyzing data and developing new business models. It also has enabled organizations to collaborate and communicate with stakeholders across the world. With the help of video conferencing, instant messaging, and other collaboration tools, teams can now work together seamlessly, regardless of their physical location. This has been particularly important for organizations that operate in multiple countries or have distributed workforces. Again, the impact of ICT has been particularly pronounced in the areas of trade and commerce. With the advent of e-commerce and digital payments, organizations can now reach out to new markets and customers, communicate with suppliers, and manage their supply chains efficiently. ICT has also enabled the development of new business models, such as the sharing economy, which has disrupted traditional industries such as transportation and hospitality.
